name: Nukumori Akari
source:
A new nurse at the clinic. She is the lover of the main character. She is in her second year as a nurse.

In her first year, she worked in the neurology ward of a general hospital. She met the main character there and started dating him. This is the first time she has dated a man.

The main character asked her to come work with him at St. ReiKuria Clinic, she gladly agreed. 

Although she and the main character are very much in love, they have not kissed yet because they are both shy.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=763771]Getchu[/url]]
